content:
Goal
* Step 2: Please change "All other arrows" to "All arrows at the other junctions" for clarity.

* The statement uses "delivery office" twice and "office" (without "delivery") three times. Please use the same terminology consistently throughout.

* Please format all instances of "L" and "R" as {{constants}}.

* In the "Recognizing a loop" section, I'm not sure whether "configuration" is the clearest term to use. Its current definition is a bit difficult to follow. Could this be simplified, perhaps by explaining that a loop occurs when the courier returns to a previously encountered state, without relying on the term "configuration"?

* Consider adding a simple example to demonstrate how to determine the number of steps before a loop begins and the length of the repeating cycle.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Next [[n]] lines" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "1" (in "1 to n"), "L" and "R" as {{constants}}.

* Line 1: Please add "space-separated" after "two".

* Next n lines: Please add "all separated by a space" after "(L or R)".

Output
* Please format "One line" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "EXIT", "0" and "LOOP" as {{constants}}.

* Please remove "positive", as the cycle length is necessarily positive when a loop occurs.

Constraints
* Please format all variables.

* Please remove the 4th and 5th constraints. The 4th is redundant, while the 5th follows naturally from the puzzle rules and doesn't impose additional restrictions on the input.

Cases
* Half of the cases use 1 as the value of [[start]]. Please revise Tests 1, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 14, 15 and 16 to use other values (not 1 and preferably not [[n]] either), while ensuring that each test remains similar to its corresponding validator.

* 12 out of 16 tests use "L" as the initial direction at every junction. Please revise Tests 1, 6, 8, 13, 14 and 15 to use R exclusively instead, while ensuring that each test remains similar to its corresponding validator.

* The final paragraph in the Goal section may need to be updated accordingly after Test 1 is revised to reflect both changes above.

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.
